summary: The change raises the auto-approve DTI ceiling from 40 % to 43 % in Policy.java and the approved parameter file, with a matching unit-test update. The substantive product obligation CRD-1 is satisfied because the code and the approved parameter are consistent and the exhaustive control test passes. However, the change modifies a protected path (controls/mortgage/policy-params.json under controls/*), which under CHG-6 requires a control_owner approval from a person on a different team from the author. No such approval appears in the records; the only approval is a code_review from a colleague on the same team. This is a clear process violation, so the change must be rejected until a control_owner approval is obtained.
